title: Writing: what is a paragraph?
competency: Write a well-developed paragraph with a topic sentence and supporting sentences.

keywords.def: A group of related sentences about one main idea.
The sentence, usually the first, that gives the main idea of a paragraph.
A sentence that gives details or examples about the main idea.

en.text: A paragraph is a group of related sentences about one main idea. The first sentence, the topic sentence, gives the main idea. The other sentences support it with details or examples, and a last sentence can conclude. Helen's paragraph uses her timetable: one supporting sentence for each day, in order, with verbs like studies, cleans and goes.

am.text: አንቀጽ ስለ አንድ ዋና ሐሳብ የተያያዙ ዓረፍተ ነገሮች ስብስብ ነው። የመጀመሪያው ዓረፍተ ነገር ዋና ሐሳቡን ይይዛል፤ ሌሎቹ ይደግፉታል።

screens.title: Find the main idea
screens.ask: Which sentence gives the main idea of the paragraph about warm weather?
opts: The warm weather allows me to play outside.
I usually hide behind a big bush.
At night, I play hide and seek.
screens.after: The first sentence is the topic sentence; the others give examples.

screens.title: A simple paragraph
paras: The warm weather allows me to play outside. I play on the ground with my brother. We run through the water and scream each time. At night, I play hide and seek with my friends. I usually hide behind a big bush. I love it when the weather is warm.
screens.note: A paragraph is a group of related sentences. The first sentence has the main idea and the other sentences support it.

screens.text: What does the last sentence, "I love it when the weather is warm," do?
screens.why: It returns to the main idea.

screens.text: Activity 2.26: put Helen's paragraph in order.
items: Helen does many things next week.
On Tuesday, she cleans the house.
screens.why: Topic sentence first, then the days in order.

screens.text: Which sentences do NOT belong in a paragraph about Helen's week?
pool: On Sunday, she plays with her friends.
screens.why: All sentences in a paragraph must support the one main idea.

screens.text: Which is the best topic sentence for a paragraph about how people in your community use calendars?
opts: People in my community use calendars to plan many activities.
screens.ans: People in my community use calendars to plan many activities.
screens.why: A topic sentence states the main idea broadly; the others are single details.
screens.clue: Which one can the other sentences support?

opts: give details about the main idea
test.ans: give details about the main idea
